newsitem.title: USA: Homeless Illinois man escapes death in landfill.
newsitem.headline: Homeless Illinois man escapes death in landfill.

text.p: A homeless man who fell asleep in a trash bin and wound up in a landfill escaped death on Wednesday just as a bulldozer was bearing down on him.
Officials at the landfill in East St. Louis, Illinois, said John Battee, 36, was drunk when he fell asleep.
Bulldozer operator James Lyons said he was rolling over the dump in a 35-ton vehicle when he saw Battee in his path, emerging from the trash.
Battee was taken to a local hospital for observation. Police said he would have been crushed had Lyons not noticed him.
